events.body:
## Context

`public/app.js` and `public/index.html` link to `https://blt.owasp.org/ambassador`, which BLT-Core doesn't route. `public/data.js` uses `bltUrl: "https://blt.owasp.org/projects/<slug>"`, but the detail route is `project/<slug>/`. Every "Become an Ambassador" and "BLT" button probably 404s.

## What to do

1. Check a few slugs on owaspblt.org first.
2. Point the ambassador CTAs at the flow the page describes (open an issue at `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/issues`) and change `bltUrl` to `/project/<slug>/`.
3. Add an assertion to `test/app.test.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No links to `/ambassador`
- [ ] `bltUrl` uses `/project/`
- [ ] Test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
node --test 'blt-nexus/test/*.test.mjs'
python3 -m http.server -d blt-nexus/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
